title: Peggy Adkins Nadeau | Obituaries | dnronline.com
text:
Peggy Adkins Nadeau, 83, of McGaheysville, Virginia, passed away peacefully on Monday, February 16, 2026.
Peggy was born on November 13, 1942, in Harrisonburg and was the daughter of the late Melvin Leon Adkins and Almeda Pearl Miller Adkins. In addition to her parents, she was preceded in death by her devoted husband of 55 years, Francis “Frank” Nadeau; her daughter, Stacey Nadeau; her sisters, Beverly Shoemaker, and Alice Adkins and her brother, Ronald Adkins.
Peggy dedicated much of her professional life to serving others as a ceramics instructor, secretary, and beloved teacher. Yet her greatest calling was that of a faithful wife and mother. A lifelong church member and devoted student of the Bible, her faith guided every aspect of her life. As a proud military spouse, she created a warm and welcoming home wherever life took her family. She and Frank graciously opened their doors to those in need, sometimes for days, weeks, or even months at a time. Peggy’s quilts and artwork brought her immense joy and became cherished treasures to many who were blessed to receive them.
She is lovingly remembered by her daughters, Kerry Kellogg (Mark) of Grottoes, and Tiffany Knupp (Carroll II) of McGaheysville; her sons, Albert Nadeau of Downingtown, Pennsylvania, and Andrew Nadeau (Jessica) of Sneads Ferry, North Carolina; eight grandchildren; two great-grandchildren, and several nieces and nephews.
A memorial service will be held at 3 p.m. on Sunday, February 22, 2026, at Kyger Funeral Home in Harrisonburg, with Pastor Reuben Horst officiating. Interment will be private at Mt. Olivet Cemetery in McGaheysville.
In lieu of flowers, memorial contributions may be made to St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital.
Condolences may be shared online at kygers.com.
